title: Hippolyte Charles, Albert Baptiste and a trombone-playing cousin
summary: Asked about Hippolyte Charles, Foster recalls his bands and the violinist Albert Baptiste and a cousin who was an early slide trombonist.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
